tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde ba can gyi zhing la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu gter 'byung ba zhes pa bzhugs// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can mus pa rje/ /gus pas btud de skal bzang skye bo rnams/ /dang 'dod yid ches dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bde ba can gyi zhing mchog bsngags par bgyi/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa/ /rgyal ba'i smon lam stobs las grub pa'i zhing / /sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen spras/ /tha gru che zhing 'od gsal 'jam zhing bde/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'du zhing bzhugs/ /ljon shing sna tshogs rin chen bdun las grub/ /yal ga lo ma me tog 'bras bur ldan/ /rlung gis skyod pas snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing / /phyogs kun chu skyes sdong pos ma khyab med/ /padmo re re'i rtse mo thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa grangs med bzhugs gyur cing / /'od dang 'od zer du mas phyogs kun khyab/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu klung dri zhim ldan/ /lha yi glu gar sil snyan sgra yi tshogs/ /rgyun chad med par rtag tu 'byung 'gyur zhing / /utpal me tog sna tshogs sa gzhi khyab/ /kun kyang mdzes shing 'od 'phro lta na sdug /tsandan spos dri zhim po rgyun mi chad/ /bya tshogs rnam mang bde gshegs sprul pa'i bya/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan dpag med sgra sgrog zhing / /lha mi thams cad gser mdog 'od zer 'phro/ /sna tshogs gos gyon rin chen rgyan cha 'phyang / /zab yangs chos kyi dga' bdes rtag tu brel/ /lha yi mig dang lha yi rna ba ldan/ /tshe rabs dran dang blo gros zad mi shes/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams lhun gyis grub 'gyur zhing / /zas gos mal cha sman dang yo byad 'byor/ /chos gos lhung bzed rin chen khang bu sogs/ /yid la bsam ma thag tu 'byung 'gyur la/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/

/de dag kun kyang sems la gang sems pa/ /skad cig nyid la 'bad med 'byung ba dang / /ngan 'gro ngan song log pa'i sgra mi bsgrog /'thab rtsod mi mthun mi dge'i las med cing / /dus rnams rtag tu byang sems snying rje ldan/ /dus dang dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma med/ /gang gis rgyal ba yid la dran pas kyang / /'chi med tshe dang mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar rmad byung zhing mchog der/ /rin chen las grub padmo'i gdan steng du/ /theg mchog rigs can dbang po rab rno ba/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa'i lus su skyes pa na/ /de ma thag tu gzungs dang ting 'dzin dang / /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul gnyis med byang chub sems/ /ye shes spyan dang thogs med spobs pa dang / /yon tan du mas shes rgyud gtams pa dang / /der ni rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes byed cing / /theg pa chen po'i dka' lung mnos gyur nas/ /de rnams khong tshud skad cig de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas rab 'byams zhing du rab bgrod de/ /der ni byang chub spyod pa rdzogs byed cing / /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ma dag zhing rnams su/ /sprul pas rang rang skad du chos bstan nas/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la 'god par 'gyur/ /de ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams yongs rdzogs shing / /'gro ba kun gyi don rnams skad cig la/ /thogs pa med pa'i tshul gyis 'grub gyur nas/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par nges/ /e ma bde ba can gyi zhing khams der/ /su zhig skyes kyang de yis rang gzhan gyi/ /don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub myur mthar phyin/ /skad cig nyid la las dang nyon mongs kyi/ /skye sgo chod nas tshe rabs gtan legs kyi/ /bde ba thob pa zhing mchog de nyid du/ /skyes pa'i phan yon thun mong min pa yin/ /mdor na phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal sras dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom skye bo'i tshogs kun gyis/ /gcig tu bsngags pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can/

/gang gi yon tan brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /de phyir de 'dra'i dag pa'i zhing mchog der/ /don gnyis bsgrub phyir skye bar rab 'dun pas/ /bsam pa dag pa'i smon lam 'debs byed pa/ /de dag ngo mtshar rmad byung skal ba bzang / /tshul 'di soms la blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams/ /dag pa'i smon lam 'debs la brtson par rigs/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen theg mchog rnal 'byor gang / /ngag dbang kun bsod grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i ming can mang thos gang de 'o/ /zhes bde ba can gyi zhing la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu gter 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'di ni skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun mus pa chen po'i zhabs rdul la spyi bos reg pa rigs sngags 'chang ba ananda'i ming can gyis zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i mdo las 'byung ba tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'i smon lam chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa sogs la brten nas bya lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga la dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba'o// //kalya na wardhantu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bde ba can gyi zhing la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu gter 'byung ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
